title: Works great for woodburning
text:
Works great for woodburning. I used these rounds for woodburning art. I was very happy with the quality of wood and the overall final piece turned out great. I used all four pieces for wood-burning and was very happy.

They are a rough cut so I had to sand them for my art. The size and bark and shape were great! I ordered 9”-11” rounds and received four 9” rounds.

product_metadata.title: Wilson 9"-11" Basswood Round, 1" Thick Rustic Wood Slice for Natural Décor, DIY Crafts (Large, Set of 4)
features: Multi-purpose basswood rounds are ideal for rustic home decor, crafts, wood burning, carving, display stands, woodland-themed centerpieces for events like weddings, baby showers, graduations, birthdays, and holidays
All basswood rounds are hand selected and kiln dried to wick away moisture and preserve the integrity of the natural bark
Each natural wood product is one-of-a-kind and may not match the picture identically; natural markings or blemishes, variations in size, shape, and color are common
Includes 4 large basswood round wood slices, measuring 9 to 12 inches wide and 1 inch thick
Natural wood products are proudly made in the USA, in Michigan's Upper Peninsula
